subject: Air freight quote request to ATL
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

My buyer in Atlanta, US, is importing laboratory glassware from us in Germany, and I am arranging the flight for their import. Could you please quote your cheapest air freight option to ATL and provide an all-in price in EUR, including truck pickup from our site in Wuppertal, Germany (postcode 42763), and transport to the departure airport?

The import shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-28. It consists of 4 pieces, with a gross weight of 497 kg and a total volume of 2.50 cbm.

Thank you for your assistance.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH

classification.reasoning: The sender is requesting a new air freight quote for a specific shipment to Atlanta.
